# Local Display Kit candidate

`conversation-display-kit-0.3.0.tgz` is the built, unpublished candidate from the
sibling Conversation Display Kit `dev` working tree, tested on 2026-09-18. Home
Huddle installs this exact artifact so a clean checkout does not depend on a
sibling repository or an unpublished registry version.

SHA-256: `8c7d29afc9e8bef9ba64144710d3ab32dd9190099a8331f5f54f139c9eadf611`.

The package includes its MIT license. After an explicitly authorized kit release,
replace the local dependency with the verified registry version and rerun the
consumer and browser checks. This artifact does not imply a published release.
